why: Current evidence shows most first missing bars are consistent with non-price-forming trades; requiring one bar every held minute is not a faithful general data model.
development_sequence: Freeze an explicit event model before a new historical outcome run, distinguishing signal price events, protective stop trigger, executable reference, missing sources and valuation freshness.
Implement and independently test valid-event progression without creating synthetic bars, zero volume, fictitious fills or profitable-price substitutions.
Keep original73 cases, all12 original cost/exit/budget variants, skipped cases, losses, unresolved exposure and censoring. Any additional family must be declared separately before its run.
Publish the full candidate registry and every result; retain current/nonPIT universe, asof mapping and source-time limits.

rules_requiring_new_registration.bar_event_model: If a new aggregate-bar stress model proceeds through absent bars under an explicit provider-series-completeness assumption, label that as a new conditional model. Do not claim absence proves no trades or broker stop execution.
rules_requiring_new_registration.execution_evidence: Quote/trade-driven alternative must freeze eligible conditions, returned versus reception timestamp, quote age, size units, bid/ask side, spread bounds, fixed intent quantity, affordability, source outage and halt handling before outcomes.
rules_requiring_new_registration.no_favorable_gap_fill: No carry-forward execution prices or selection of a favorable later tick. Missing required execution evidence keeps that action unresolved.
rules_requiring_new_registration.capital: Initial500 whole shares, no borrowing, T+1 receivables, no exit-day re-entry, no restart injections; corporate action adjustments must be supported or explicit unresolved.
rules_requiring_new_registration.cohort_portfolio_diagnostics: A separately labeled retrospective verified-news cohort could explore capital continuity, but it must explicitly acknowledge post-observation selection; it cannot replace unknown full-market paths or prove historical implementability. All original candidates remain retained.

restarts: Separate later protocol must freeze demonstrated inability-to-trade criterion and count every injection/residual/failed round; old40pct stop not governing user goal.
validation_requirement: No historical revised variant is out-of-sample merely because its code is new. Use a genuinely unobserved chronological period or prospective observations for edge claims.
data_next: First specify required observation streams and a bounded all-case acquisition design; the38point archive alone does not cover every future held gap or exit.
